mapper.insert: insert into equipment ( code, name, equipment_type_id, area_id, model, manufacturer, serial_number, install_date, status, remark ) values ( #{code}, #{name}, #{equipmentTypeId}, #{areaId}, #{model}, #{manufacturer}, #{serialNumber}, #{installDate}, #{status}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: select e.id, e.code, e.name, e.equipment_type_id, et.name as equipment_type_name, e.area_id, a.name as area_name, e.status, e.last_inspection_at, e.model, e.manufacturer, e.serial_number, e.install_date, e.remark, e.created_at, e.updated_at from equipment e inner join equipment_type et on et.id = e.equipment_type_id inner join area a on a.id = e.area_id where e.id = #{equipmentId}
mapper.update: update equipment set code = #{code}, name = #{name}, equipment_type_id = #{equipmentTypeId}, area_id = #{areaId}, model = #{model}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, serial_number = #{serialNumber}, install_date = #{installDate}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from inspection_plan_equipment where equipment_id = #{equipmentId}) + (select count(*) from inspection_task_equipment where equipment_id = #{equipmentId}) + (select count(*) from inspection_record where equipment_id = #{equipmentId}) + (select count(*) from fault_record where equipment_id = #{equipmentId}) + (select count(*) from work_order where equipment_id = #{equipmentId})
mapper.update: update equipment set last_inspection_at = #{inspectedAt}, status = case when #{abnormal} = true and status = 'NORMAL' then 'FAULT' else status end where id = #{equipmentId}
update equipment set status = 'IN_REPAIR' where id = #{equipmentId} and status = 'FAULT'

update equipment e set status = 'NORMAL' where e.id = #{equipmentId} and e.status in ('FAULT', 'IN_REPAIR') and not exists ( select 1 from work_order w where w.equipment_id = e.id and w.status in ('PENDING_ASSIGNMENT', 'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE', 'PROCESSING', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION', 'REJECTED') )
